sourceEvidence.title: Senior Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
- Strategy: Define and execute a multi-year strategy across the entire product lifecycle, from design gate to aftermarket service.
- Operations: Drive systemic improvements in key performance indicators (KPIs) related to product reliability, manufacturing yield, and operational efficiency across the global enterprise.
- Collaboration: Partner with Systems Integration project stakeholders, international deployment teams, and business leadership to ensure quality metrics are aligned with and support business needs. 

Core Responsibilities 

- Process Quality: Enforcement of field deployment processes and verification of process capability. 
- Lifecycle Performance: Ensure downstream impact from system deployments are analyzed and translated into applicable product and process improvements.
- Compliance & Governance: Manage internal audit programs to ensure the International Systems Integration business adheres to Quality Management System (QMS), ISO 9001 standards, and regulatory requirements.
- Issue Resolution: Lead root cause analysis and execute corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) for quality issues that impact project deployments.
- Continuous Improvement: Drive a culture of operational excellence using data analysis and quality tools to eliminate waste and improve system deployment capabilities.
